context.title: Santee Fire Fighters Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Santee — Measure Y (Santee Local Services & Infrastructure Sales Tax Measure)

positions.statement: Adam Daniels (President, Santee Fire Fighters Association) signed the argument in favor of Santee Measure Y and the rebuttal to the argument against Santee Measure Y in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
